scientific_purpose: On original genuine licensed PSF CPython 3.13 publisher documents (already exposed DEV), test whether trained source current native query q_t retrieves historically observed writer w_{a-1} whose prior source byte context exactly equals current last L observed bytes. Context labels are derived from PAST OBSERVED ORIGINAL bytes only, not query target raw[t+1]. Compare original frozen original query/cosine nearest-writer selection to exact-history matching, deterministic same-source uniform random and highest-cosine deliberately wrong-context decoy; no training, no unseen generalization or future-label oracle. Explicit small bounded history H=32/128/256 source bytes and context length L=2/3/4. Report availability/coverage, match rank, retrieval next-byte accuracy and original TAC next-byte NLL. Exact-history baseline keeps raw past bytes and all writer keys for analysis and is NOT 4160B edge-deployed.

real_world_source.name: PSF CPython 3.13.0 tutorial original publisher bytes

causal_protocol: For each original actual four PSF DEV publisher source owner, restore three trained 078 499627 checkpoint seeds (original source model/optimizer/RNG/source schedule SHA); run unchanged original DualNativeStreamingTAC079(true carried original raw0..319), capture at each original write clock a>=4 the learned original source writer address w_{a-1} and actual observed history continuation raw[a]. At each query clock t=128..319, after observing raw[t] and producing source model logits and source current native learned query q_t, construct ALL candidate prior a with 4<=a<t and age 1..H for H in(32,128,256). For L in(2,3,4), exact context-match is raw[a-L:a]==raw[t-L+1:t+1], strictly past/current observed, NEVER raw[t+1]. Compute learned cosine top1 writer across candidates, rank/reciprocal rank of highest exact-context-matching historical writer only when at least one match, highest-scoring explicit WRONG-context candidate (negative control), frozen deterministic uniform random-index history baseline, and exact-history most recent matching known past byte plus Dirichlet-smoothed original observed continuation distribution p(y|history)=(count+8/256)/(n+8). Only then read actual raw[t+1] to score true next-byte accuracy/NLL. Source owner clock/actual next byte labels and original model checkpoint+model next byte precision SHA identical across all seeds. Unseen DEV not claimed. Do not train, optimize any key, tune smoothing or choose target clock from future label.
